_readme: Template for BOTH parties' consent in a real bilateral dispute fixture. Section A is the legally meaningful record; section B is the named DISCLOSURE SCOPE (what reviewers may see, what is withheld, for how long, and how either party revokes consent — one scope, both parties, one fixtureRef); section C shows the exact wire format the DDE engine verifies (E5 CONSENT_BINDING). Fill every field, sign the digests off-platform with each party's own key, and never paste private keys anywhere. Nothing in this template is legal advice — parties should have their own counsel review the underlying agreement and the scope of disclosure.

A_redactionGrants._who: PARTY A — fill for the first party (e.g. the client/principal)
A_redactionGrants.grantorAddress: 0x… (party A's own wallet address; E5 replays the signature to this exact address)
A_redactionGrants.fixtureRef: 0x… (32-byte hex — computed in step 2 of the procedure; both parties MUST sign the same value)
A_redactionGrants.scope: One-line summary of the shared disclosure scope in section B (the E5-replayed string); the full scope lives in section B_disclosureScope.

signature.digest: 0x… (EIP-712 digest of grantor/fixtureRef/scope below domain 'CoreGuard DDE Redaction Grant' v1 chainId 1116 — sign off-platform, or via tools/e2e-sign)

A_redactionGrants._who: PARTY B — same fields, party B's own key and address
A_redactionGrants.fixtureRef: 0x… (identical to party A's — one fixture, one reference)
A_redactionGrants.scope: One-line summary of the shared disclosure scope in section B — MUST be the identical string in both grants.

B_disclosureScope._what: The named disclosure scope for this intake — one scope, signed by both parties over the same fixtureRef. Answer each of the six questions explicitly; empty fields keep the gate red.
B_disclosureScope.attribution: How each party wishes to be named, or 'anonymous party A/B'

crossChecks._what: Signed by both parties as an integrity declaration — the gate cross-checks these against the removed-data checklist and the records as submitted.
crossChecks.checklistRef: DDE-REAL-INTAKE-REMOVAL-v1 for the same caseRef, completed and signed

C_recordClosureConsent.closureEffect: After closure no party may edit their submitted records; further submissions require a new fixture.
C_recordClosureConsent.remedyAgreed: NONE | REWORK | PARTIAL_REFUND | FULL_REFUND | CREDIT — the closed remedy vocabulary; anything outside it is rejected by the engine (B3)

D_declarations.noCoercion: Both parties confirm consent was given freely.
D_declarations.perjuryAwareness: Both parties confirm the statements above are accurate to the best of their knowledge.

_provenance: TEMPLATE — a fill-in guide with zero real data; never submit this file itself as a consent record. Sections map to the procedure README: A → E5-replayed grants (C wire format), B → the disclosure scope (copy into consent-and-disclosure.json disclosure), C → record closure, D → declarations. Cross-checked by examples/real-fixture-intake/prelude.mjs (gate) and contract-tested in test/delivery/intake.test.js.
